finding.claim: Stored SSRF: attacker-supplied callbackUrl is stored without any validation and later POSTed to by the server every minute, allowing requests to internal services, cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), localhost, etc. with the payload as body.

trace.note: stored in subscriptions map with no scheme/host/IP validation
HttpClient.send issues the POST to the attacker-chosen URL

finding.guards_checked: No allowlist, scheme check, private/loopback/link-local IP block, or DNS pinning in subscribe or notifyAll. The thumb() endpoint is not affected: its fully anchored matches() regex pins the host to cdn.example.com, and HttpClient does not follow redirects by default.

verdict.reason: src/Jobs.java:14 stores callbackUrl unvalidated and src/Jobs.java:21-24 POSTs to it via URI.create(cb) and client.send. No scheme, host or IP checks exist, and no other file references subscribe, so there is no authentication or middleware guard. The thumb() regex at line 30 is fully anchored and does not affect this path.
